name: The Sandmaw's Pit
description: A funnel of sliding sand and old stone, and under it a nest of burrows that has been used for longer than anyone has kept count.

rim.name: The Funnel's Edge
rim.description: The path ends on a ledge of old stone halfway down the funnel. Sand trickles past you in a never-ending hush, and the way on leads east along the wall, where the stone turns to burrow.

slope.name: The Spiral Slope
slope.description: A ramp of packed grit winds down the inside of the funnel, scored with the long grooves of something dragged. Burrows open south and east.

burrows_a.name: The Lower Burrows
burrows_a.description: A round, low-roofed chamber tunnelled out of hardpan, floored with sand as soft as flour. A half-buried chest sticks out of one wall. The only way out is back up the tunnel.

burrows_b.name: The Winding Burrows
burrows_b.description: A knot of tunnels, all alike, that slope steadily down. The air is dry and hot, and the walls are polished by a great many passings. One tunnel runs south, deeper.

nest.name: The Nest
nest.description: A wide, domed chamber, its floor heaped with the dry husks of things that were once larger than you. Something has been laying here. At the far end of the dome, a passage slopes down into a darkness that moves.

east.failure_message: You step toward the passage, and the sand under your feet begins to slide.

maw.name: The Maw
maw.description: The bottom of the funnel: a round pit of loose white sand walled with old, black stone. In the middle of it, the sand rises and falls like breath.
